Delhi Government to Halt, Recover Funds from Ineligible Lakshmi Yojana Beneficiaries

The Delhi government has announced that beneficiaries of the Delhi Lakshmi Yojana found to be ineligible will face the stoppage of aid. Additionally, the government plans to recover funds already disbursed to these ineligible recipients. This action aims to ensure that the scheme's benefits reach only the intended beneficiaries.
